Cost: Provided with the Operating System
Slots: 5

Cyberdeck with 5 slots that take Programs or Hardware. Jacking In to a target's Neuroport with it gives +1 on the contested check to stay unnoticed; another Netrunner only notices the user at the end of their next Turn; and Jacking In stealthily to a non-Neuroport architecture gives +2 on the initial Interface check.

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
